row: Kathryn Mann and Bena Tshishiku, Realization problems for diffeomorphism groups, arXiv:1802.00490v1 (1 February 2018), Theorem 4.1. Smooth disk B₃ realization, its double branched cover and identity-collar extension give actual C∞ right-Dehn-twist lifts A,B on any oriented surface for curves meeting once, satisfying ABA=BAB. This fully answers original Problem 9 and its homeomorphism/C¹/Cʳ versions. No splitting of the entire ambient mapping class group, or extra relations in an ambient quotient, is claimed. This row links the inspected preprint and its existing DOI. The related journal chapter is Breadth in Contemporary Topology, Proceedings of Symposia in Pure Mathematics 102 (2019), 131–156, DOI 10.1090/pspum/102/11; its metadata is verified, but its PDF was not authenticated. PR #1114; existing prior result.
